whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this WhatsApp and remove the saved link?
whatsapp.qr_help: On your phone: WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device.
whatsapp.setup_1: Connect WhatsApp and scan the QR Code as a linked device.
whatsapp.setup_2: Create a group containing only your own account.
whatsapp.setup_3: Return here and choose that group as the authorized group.
whatsapp.setup_4: Send /help in the group to confirm the connection and see the current state.
whatsapp.restriction: The bot responds only to your messages in the selected group. Other groups and participants are ignored.
whatsapp.guide_intro: Check the cycle workout, log exercises, and correct the session directly from the conversation.
whatsapp.flow_preview_body: View the expected workout with /today without opening a session.
whatsapp.flow_start_body: Use /start to create the session and receive the numbered sequence.
whatsapp.flow_record_body: Reply with one line per exercise or skip an item by its number.
whatsapp.flow_complete_body: The session finishes automatically once every item is logged or skipped.
whatsapp.command_today_body: Shows the next workout without starting it. If a session is open, it also shows current progress. Accepts /hoje.
whatsapp.command_start_body: Creates the next workout in the cycle or displays the open session again. Use --link to include videos.
whatsapp.command_last_body: Shows the open session or the latest workout by session date. Accepts /ultimo.
whatsapp.command_history_body: Summarizes this week's workouts, status, exercises, sets, volume, and duration. Accepts /historico.
whatsapp.command_log_body: Exercise 1, 100 kg, 3 sets of 15 repetitions, and RIR 1. Only works during an open session.
whatsapp.command_skip_body: Marks item 3 as skipped. Logging that item later includes it in the session again. Accepts /pular 3.
whatsapp.command_end_body: Closes the open session as incomplete and preserves everything already logged. Accepts /fim and /finalizar.
whatsapp.command_edit_review_body: Shows the date, workout, and values for the open session or latest finished session.
whatsapp.command_edit_value_body: Replaces the recorded sets for exercise 1 in the session shown by /edit. Accepts /editar.
whatsapp.command_help_body: With no open session it lists commands. During a workout it reports progress, the next exercise, and available actions. Accepts /ajuda.
whatsapp.command_clear_body: Attempts to delete tracked group messages, including the command itself. Accepts /clean and /limpar.
whatsapp.format_fuzzy: Commands and units tolerate small typos and Portuguese aliases.
whatsapp.format_units: Use kg, k, kilo, lb, or lbs. Pounds are converted to kilograms.
whatsapp.format_order: Load and RIR may appear in a different order; keep sets and repetitions together with x, ×, *, or /.
whatsapp.format_limits: Each entry accepts 1–20 sets and a maximum load of 999 kg to catch typing mistakes.
whatsapp.rule_session: Only one session can be open; /start resumes it instead of creating another.
whatsapp.rule_edit: /edit targets the open session or latest finished session by workout date, not by its latest change.
whatsapp.rule_skip: Logging or skipping every exercise completes the workout automatically.
whatsapp.rule_links: YouTube links appear only with --link on /start or /today.
whatsapp.cleanup_body: WhatsApp may prevent old messages from being removed. The bot can only delete messages tracked since it connected and reports any message it could not remove.
